source_tier: trade press + sponsor IR (three independent: LNG Prime, Offshore Energy, Crown LNG GlobeNewswire release)
source_notes: As of 2025-2026 reporting, Crown LNG consistently states it expects to reach FID for the Kakinada GBS terminal in 2026 (first gas 2029), with construction starting 2026. Three independent non-GEM sources each explicitly state FID 2026: LNG Prime, Offshore Energy, and Crown LNG's own GlobeNewswire press release. GEM currently records FIDYear 2025 with FIDStatus Pre-FID, which appears to be a stale/optimistic target. FIDStatus remains Pre-FID. Note terminal is a gravity-based structure (GBSRU), not an FSRU; capacity 7.2 mtpa and ~$1bn cost are unchanged/corroborated.
scope_note: Project-level FID field; single unit row.
